sentences.en: 33 presidents.
sentences.zh: 33位总统。

sentences.en: I called the president at 4.30 in the morning and he answered.
sentences.zh: 我凌晨4点半给总统打了电话，他接了。

sentences.en: Seven decades in space.
sentences.zh: 太空探索七十年。

sentences.en: We want to see what's beyond the next star.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗恒星之外有什么。

sentences.en: A thousand consumer product guides.
sentences.zh: 一千份消费品指南。

sentences.en: Today I am testing seven mattresses.
sentences.zh: 今天我正在测试七款床垫。

sentences.en: 60 super sundaes.
sentences.zh: 60份超级圣代。

sentences.en: They were probably the best team in the league every single year.
sentences.zh: 他们可能每年都是联盟里最强的球队。

sentences.en: 53,500 puzzles.
I use a different starting word every day.
sentences.zh: 我每天都用不同的起始词。

sentences.en: 25,000 recipes.
And I love a one pan recipe because I don't love washing pans.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢一锅出的食谱，因为我不喜欢洗锅。

sentences.en: The New York Times, celebrating 175 years of helping you understand the world and make the most of each day.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》，庆祝175年来致力于帮助您了解世界并充分利用每一天。

sentences.en: Subscribe now for a special offer at nytimes.com slash subscribe.
sentences.zh: 现在订阅可享特别优惠，请访问 nytimes.com 斜杠 subscribe。

sentences.en: Hey, it's Michael.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是迈克尔。

sentences.en: Just a quick note.
sentences.zh: 简单说两句。

sentences.en: Today's episode contains some graphic depictions of violence.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目包含一些暴力场面的描述。

sentences.en: May it please the court counsel.
sentences.zh: 请法庭和律师准许。

sentences.en: On February 22nd, Jose Ibarra put on a black hat, a hoodie style jacket, and some black kitchen style disposable gloves.
sentences.zh: 2月22日，何塞·伊瓦拉戴上了一顶黑色帽子、一件连帽夹克，还有一副黑色厨房用一次性手套。

sentences.en: And he went hunting for females on the University of Georgia's campus.
sentences.zh: 他前往佐治亚大学校园寻找女性目标。

sentences.en: And in his hunt, he encountered 22-year-old Lakin Riley on her morning jog.
sentences.zh: 在搜寻过程中，他遇到了正在晨跑的22岁女孩莱金·莱利。

sentences.en: And when Lakin Riley refused to be his rape victim, he bashed her skull in with a rock repeatedly.
sentences.zh: 当莱金·莱利拒绝成为他的强奸受害者时，他用石头反复猛击她的头部。

sentences.en: That is what this case is all about.
sentences.zh: 这就是本案的全部内容。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》节目。

sentences.en: On Wednesday afternoon, inside a courtroom in Athens, Georgia, a guilty verdict was reached in what prosecutors have described as a cut-and-dried case of cold-blooded murder.
sentences.zh: 周三下午，在佐治亚州雅典市的一间法庭内，针对这起被检察官描述为冷血谋杀的案件，陪审团做出了有罪判决。

sentences.en: But outside that courtroom, the case has become something far bigger.
sentences.zh: 但在法庭之外，这起案件的影响力已经远不止于此。

sentences.en: Today, national reporter Rick Rojas on how the death of Lakin Riley has become a flashpoint in the national debate over border security, illegal immigration, and mass deportation.
sentences.zh: 今天，全国记者里克·罗哈斯将讲述莱金·莱利的死是如何成为全国关于边境安全、非法移民和大规模驱逐出境辩论的焦点。

sentences.en: It's Thursday, November 21St.
sentences.zh: 今天是11月21日，星期四。

sentences.en: Rick, tell us about the woman at the center of this entire story, Lakin Riley.
sentences.zh: 里克，给我们讲讲这个故事核心的女孩，莱金·莱利。

sentences.en: So Lakin Riley is a 22-year-old nursing student living in Athens, which is a bustling college town here in Georgia.
sentences.zh: 莱金·莱利是一名22岁的护理系学生，住在佐治亚州雅典市，这是一个热闹的大学城。

sentences.en: It's about an hour, hour and a half away from Atlanta.
sentences.zh: 距离亚特兰大大约一个小时到一个半小时的车程。

sentences.en: And she's just leading a very kind of normal college life.
sentences.zh: 她过着非常普通的大学生活。

sentences.en: She lives in a house close to the University of Georgia campus with a group of roommates.
sentences.zh: 她和一群室友住在靠近佐治亚大学校园的一栋房子里。

sentences.en: They talk about each other like they're family.
sentences.zh: 她们谈论彼此就像家人一样。

sentences.en: Telecommunications from their phones so they can keep an eye on each other.
sentences.zh: 她们共享手机定位，这样就能互相照应。

sentences.en: And Lakin is an avid runner.
sentences.zh: 莱金还是个狂热的跑步爱好者。

sentences.en: She regularly suits up and takes a long jog.
sentences.zh: 她经常换上装备去长跑。

sentences.en: And that's exactly what she did on the morning of February 22nd.
sentences.zh: 2月22日那天早上，她正是这么做的。

sentences.en: At about 9 a.m., she heads out for a run.
sentences.zh: 大约早上9点，她出门跑步。

sentences.en: And then she heads into the woods running on what is usually a very placid, peaceful, widely considered safe place.
sentences.zh: 随后她跑进了树林，那里通常被认为是一个非常宁静、平和且相当安全的地方。

sentences.en: The first sign of trouble comes about 10 minutes later.
sentences.zh: 大约10分钟后，出现了第一个异常迹象。

sentences.en: She activates the emergency function on her iPhone, and it calls 911.
sentences.zh: 她激活了iPhone上的紧急功能，并拨打了911。

sentences.en: A dispatcher picks up the phone and keeps asking if anyone's there, but the line is silent.
sentences.zh: 调度员接通了电话，不断询问是否有人在，但电话那头一片寂静。

sentences.en: For almost a minute, there's no response.
sentences.zh: 近一分钟的时间里，没有任何回应。

sentences.en: And then you hear a faint voice saying,
sentences.zh: 然后你听到一个微弱的声音说，

sentences.en: Yo tango, or I have, in Spanish.
sentences.zh: “Yo tango”，也就是西班牙语的“我有”。

sentences.en: And then the call ends.
sentences.zh: 随后通话结束了。

sentences.en: After about an hour from 9 a.m.
sentences.zh: 从早上9点开始，过了一个小时，

sentences.en: to 10 a.m.
sentences.zh: 到了10点，

sentences.en: and then to 11 a.m.,
sentences.zh: 又到了11点，

sentences.en: Lakin's roommates start to get worried about her.
sentences.zh: 莱金的室友们开始为她担心。

sentences.en: Like, where is she?
sentences.zh: 她们想，她去哪了？

sentences.en: What happened?
sentences.zh: 发生了什么事？

sentences.en: And so that's when they use the location sharing function on the phone to try to track her down.
sentences.zh: 于是她们使用了手机上的位置共享功能试图追踪她。

sentences.en: It did not give a precise location, but it gave them a rough sense of where she was.
sentences.zh: 虽然没有给出精确位置，但让她们大致了解了她所在的地方。

sentences.en: And in the course of looking for her, one of her roommates actually finds one of her AirPods on the ground.
sentences.zh: 在寻找她的过程中，其中一名室友在地上发现了她的一只AirPods耳机。

sentences.en: And that's like a very chilling sign that, you know, something's going on with Lakin.
sentences.zh: 这真是一个令人不寒而栗的信号，你知道，莱金出事了。

sentences.en: That's when they call in the police.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，她们报了警。

sentences.en: And so a campus police officer from the University of Georgia sets out looking for her.
sentences.zh: 于是佐治亚大学的一名校警出发寻找她。

sentences.en: And they find her shortly after noon that day.
sentences.zh: 当天中午过后不久，他们找到了她。

sentences.en: Her body has been dragged about 60 feet from the trail.
sentences.zh: 她的尸体被拖离小径约60英尺远。

sentences.en: She's been covered with leaves.
sentences.zh: 她身上覆盖着树叶。

sentences.en: Her top has been lifted over her head.
sentences.zh: 她的上衣被掀到了头顶上方。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: She's bloodied, clearly beaten.
sentences.zh: 她浑身是血，显然遭到了殴打。

sentences.en: And it's clear from that moment that there's been a vicious attack that ended in Lakin Riley's death.
sentences.zh: 从那一刻起，很明显发生了一场导致莱金·莱利死亡的残暴袭击。

sentences.en: So not long after Lakin's body is discovered, investigators start finding all kinds of evidence.
sentences.zh: 在发现莱金的尸体后不久，调查人员就开始发现各种证据。

sentences.en: They find a bloody jacket that's been thrown away in a dumpster.
sentences.zh: 他们发现了一件被扔在垃圾箱里的带血夹克。

sentences.en: They find security camera footage showing someone throwing that jacket away.
sentences.zh: 他们找到了监控录像，显示有人扔掉了那件夹克。

sentences.en: They find her phone with a thumbprint on it.
sentences.zh: 他们找到了她带有指纹的手机。

sentences.en: They find DNA evidence under her fingernails that they believe shows who her attacker was.
sentences.zh: 他们在她的指甲下发现了DNA证据，他们认为这显示了袭击者是谁。

sentences.en: And they quickly find and arrest her suspected killer.
sentences.zh: 他们很快就找到并逮捕了这名涉嫌杀害她的凶手。

sentences.en: And as far as the authorities are concerned, like, it's a pretty open and shut case.
sentences.zh: 在当局看来，这案子相当简单明了。

sentences.en: Like, it's very straightforward who they believe did this and that they have the evidence to back that up.
sentences.zh: 他们认为谁干的非常清楚，而且他们有证据支持这一点。

sentences.en: As awful as this case is, as gruesome as the details are, it's also not the sort of case that would necessarily rise to a national news story
sentences.zh: 尽管这起案件极其恶劣，细节也令人毛骨悚然，但它原本不至于上升到全国性新闻的高度，

sentences.en: until we find out who the police have arrested.
sentences.zh: 直到我们发现警方逮捕了谁。

sentences.en: What do you mean?
sentences.zh: 你是什么意思？

sentences.en: So we quickly learned that the suspect had come into the United States illegally.
sentences.zh: 我们很快得知，这名嫌疑人是非法进入美国的。

sentences.en: And suddenly, this is no longer simply a local murder case.
sentences.zh: 突然之间，这不再仅仅是一起地方谋杀案了。

sentences.en: It becomes something much bigger.
sentences.zh: 它变成了一件影响深远得多的事情。

sentences.en: And it becomes a political symbol.
sentences.zh: 它变成了一个政治符号。

sentences.en: Which we're going to get to.
sentences.zh: 我们稍后会谈到这一点。

sentences.en: But Rick, first, tell us about this suspect and how he ended up in these woods near the University of Georgia.
sentences.zh: 但里克，首先请告诉我们关于这个嫌疑人的情况，以及他是如何来到佐治亚大学附近这片树林的。

sentences.en: So Jose Antonio Ibarra is a 26-year-old migrant from Venezuela who had this circuitous path that led him to Athens, Georgia.
sentences.zh: 何塞·安东尼奥·伊瓦拉是一名26岁的委内瑞拉移民，他走了一条曲折的道路才来到佐治亚州雅典市。

sentences.en: He entered the United States illegally on the border near El Paso, Texas in September of 2022.
sentences.zh: 他于2022年9月在德克萨斯州埃尔帕索附近的边境非法进入美国。

sentences.en: And he's arrested by immigration authorities.
sentences.zh: 他被移民当局逮捕。

sentences.en: And then he is released while his case is being reviewed.
sentences.zh: 随后他在案件审查期间被释放。

sentences.en: It's happening in a time when the border and the Biden administration in particular has just been overwhelmed by a surge in border crossings
sentences.zh: 当时正值边境，特别是拜登政府，被激增的边境越境人数所淹没的时期，

sentences.en: and particularly with migrants coming from Venezuela.
sentences.zh: 尤其是来自委内瑞拉的移民。

sentences.en: Migrants like Mr. Ibarra.
sentences.zh: 像伊瓦拉先生这样的移民。

sentences.en: So what happens to him once he's released into the United States?
sentences.zh: 那么他被释放进入美国后发生了什么？

sentences.en: He heads to New York City.
sentences.zh: 他前往了纽约市。

sentences.en: First, he goes to Queens.
sentences.zh: 起初，他去了皇后区。

sentences.en: He stays at a Crown Plaza hotel there that had been converted into a migrant shelter.
sentences.zh: 他住在那里的一家皇冠假日酒店，该酒店已被改建为移民收容所。

sentences.en: And while he was in New York, in August of 2022, he was arrested for driving a scooter without a license with a child who was not wearing a helmet.
sentences.zh: 在纽约期间，即2022年8月，他因无证驾驶滑板车且搭载一名未戴头盔的儿童而被捕。

sentences.en: He was not prosecuted or jailed in that case.
sentences.zh: 在那起案件中，他没有被起诉或入狱。

sentences.en: A few weeks later, he goes to the Roosevelt Hotel in Manhattan, which had become the city's official welcome center for migrants.
sentences.zh: 几周后，他去了曼哈顿的罗斯福酒店，那里已成为该市官方的移民接待中心。

sentences.en: And he goes through a process that's known as reticketing, where the city pays for migrants to move elsewhere.
sentences.zh: 他经历了一个被称为“重新购票”的过程，即由市政府出钱让移民搬到其他地方。

sentences.en: And so he gets a ticket to leave for Atlanta on September 28th.
sentences.zh: 于是他在9月28日拿到了一张前往亚特兰大的车票。

sentences.en: And that's how he ends up in Athens and Georgia, where his brother already is and has found work.
sentences.zh: 这就是他最终来到佐治亚州雅典市的原因，他的兄弟已经在那里找到了工作。

sentences.en: So he briefly becomes part of this wave of migrants that those of us who live in New York City remember really well.
sentences.zh: 所以他短暂地成为了我们这些住在纽约市的人记忆深刻的那波移民潮的一部分。

sentences.en: There are so many coming so quickly that the city sets up a bunch of hotels and shelters to deal with them and ultimately allows some, perhaps even encourages some,
sentences.zh: 由于涌入的人数太多太快，市政府设立了许多酒店和收容所来安置他们，并最终允许甚至鼓励一些人，

sentences.en: it sounds like including Ibarra, to leave New York City and go someplace else to relieve the pressure on city resources.
sentences.zh: 听起来包括伊瓦拉在内，离开纽约市去其他地方，以减轻城市资源的压力。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And so at that point, he moves to Athens and lives in an apartment complex that's just a short walking distance from the University of Georgia campus
sentences.zh: 在那之后，他搬到了雅典市，住在一个距离佐治亚大学校园仅几步之遥的公寓大楼里，

sentences.en: that's home to working-class immigrants who have ended up here in this Georgia city from all over the place, including Asia and Latin America.
sentences.zh: 那里住着来自世界各地，包括亚洲和拉丁美洲，最终落脚在这个佐治亚州城市的工薪阶层移民。

sentences.en: And so then in October, just a few more weeks after he arrives in Georgia, he and his brother are both arrested in connection with a shoplifting case at a local Walmart.
sentences.zh: 接着在10月，也就是他抵达佐治亚州仅几周后，他和他的兄弟因涉嫌在当地一家沃尔玛超市行窃而被捕。

sentences.en: But he's not detained.
sentences.zh: 但他没有被拘留。

sentences.en: The authorities run his name through state and national databases at the time but don't find any warrants for him.
sentences.zh: 当时当局在州和国家数据库中查询了他的名字，但没有发现针对他的逮捕令。

sentences.en: And so he's released.
sentences.zh: 于是他被释放了。

sentences.en: So I just want to be sure I understand.
sentences.zh: 我想确认我是否理解正确。

sentences.en: At this point, he's been arrested three times.
sentences.zh: 此时，他已经被逮捕了三次。

sentences.en: First time when he enters a country unlawfully.
sentences.zh: 第一次是非法入境时。

sentences.en: But then he is released.
sentences.zh: 但随后他被释放了。

sentences.en: A second time in New York City for the scooter incident.
sentences.zh: 第二次是在纽约市，因为滑板车事件。

sentences.en: Now a third time for shoplifting.
sentences.zh: 现在是第三次，因为行窃。

sentences.en: And at no point, it sounds like, is there any effort to detain him for some meaningful period or perhaps deport him.
sentences.zh: 听起来在任何时候，都没有人试图对他进行长时间的拘留，或者可能将他驱逐出境。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And so because of all of this, his immigration status, his previous arrests, his repeated releases, when he's arrested for murdering Lake and Riley, the case just blows up.
sentences.zh: 正因为这一切，他的移民身份、之前的逮捕记录以及反复的释放，当他因谋杀莱金·莱利被捕时，这起案件彻底爆发了。

sentences.en: You know, I said earlier it became a political symbol.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我刚才说过它变成了一个政治符号。

sentences.en: And remember the timing.
sentences.zh: 记住这个时间点。

sentences.en: It's February and a presidential election year.
sentences.zh: 现在是2月，正值总统大选年。

sentences.en: This is Georgia, a swing state.
sentences.zh: 这是佐治亚州，一个摇摆州。

sentences.en: And illegal immigration is a huge priority for voters.
sentences.zh: 非法移民是选民最关心的问题之一。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So Republicans all the way up to Donald Trump decide that this is the case to focus on.
sentences.zh: 所以共和党人，一直到唐纳德·特朗普，都决定将这起案件作为重点。

sentences.en: This, for them, is the case that encapsulates all the dangers of illegal migration.
sentences.zh: 对他们来说，这就是概括了非法移民所有危险的典型案例。

sentences.en: And they're going to talk about it and talk about it and talk about it as much as humanly possible.
sentences.zh: 他们会尽可能多地谈论这件事。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们稍后回来。

sentences.en: I'm Winnalou.
sentences.zh: 我是温娜露。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我负责编写《纽约时报》游戏中的拼图游戏《Connections》。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我还喜欢试图捉弄你们。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Mazursky.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·马祖斯基。

sentences.en: And I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我每天负责创作《Spelling Bee》和《Letterboxd》游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做“联觉”的特质。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我在听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由人制作的。

sentences.en: Like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 就像你们刚刚听到的这些人一样。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 请访问 nytimes.com 斜杠 games，今天就开始玩吧。

sentences.en: So, Rick, what exactly do Republicans do with this case back in February once Jose Ibarra is arrested and his immigration status becomes widely understood?
sentences.zh: 那么，里克，2月份何塞·伊瓦拉被捕且其移民身份广为人知后，共和党人究竟是如何利用这起案件的？

sentences.en: They waste no time speaking out about it.
sentences.zh: 他们毫不迟疑地对此发声。

sentences.en: Our hearts are breaking this morning for the family of Lake and Riley.
sentences.zh: 今天早上，我们为莱金·莱利的家人感到心碎。

sentences.en: Just two days after Lake and Riley is killed, Brian Kemp, Georgia's Republican governor, sends a letter to President Biden demanding answers about Jose Ibarra's immigration status.
sentences.zh: 在莱金·莱利遇害仅两天后，佐治亚州共和党州长布莱恩·肯普致信拜登总统，要求就何塞·伊瓦拉的移民身份给出答复。

sentences.en: Lake and Riley's death is a direct result of failed policies on the federal level and an unwillingness by this White House to secure the southern border.
sentences.zh: 莱金·莱利的死是联邦层面政策失败以及本届白宫不愿确保南部边境安全的直接后果。

sentences.en: And he even delivers a speech about it where he just rips into Biden.
sentences.zh: 他甚至发表了一场演讲，在演讲中严厉抨击了拜登。

sentences.en: And because of the White House's failures, every state is now a border state.
sentences.zh: 由于白宫的失败，现在每个州都成了边境州。

sentences.en: And Lake and Riley's murder is just the latest proof of that.
sentences.zh: 而莱金·莱利的谋杀案只是最新的证明。

sentences.en: And then, two weeks later, Georgia Republicans bring the issue to President Biden even more directly at his State of the Union address.
sentences.zh: 两周后，佐治亚州的共和党人在拜登总统发表国情咨文时，更直接地将这一问题摆到了他面前。

sentences.en: Mr. Speaker, the President of the United States!
sentences.zh: 议长先生，美利坚合众国总统！

sentences.en: As President Biden enters the House of Representatives, he is confronted by Marjorie Taylor Greene, a Republican representative from Georgia.
sentences.zh: 当拜登总统走进众议院时，他遭到了来自佐治亚州的共和党众议员玛乔丽·泰勒·格林的质问。

sentences.en: She's wearing a T-shirt that says, say her name.
sentences.zh: 她穿着一件印有“说出她的名字”字样的T恤。

sentences.en: She's wearing a pin with Lake and Riley's face on it.
sentences.zh: 她戴着一枚印有莱肯·莱利头像的徽章。

sentences.en: And then, during the speech...
sentences.zh: 随后，在演讲过程中……

sentences.en: My team began serious negotiations of the bipartisan...
sentences.zh: 我的团队开始就两党……进行严肃谈判。

sentences.en: As President Biden starts to talk about legislative efforts to address immigration issues, Representative Greene speaks up.
sentences.zh: 当拜登总统开始谈论解决移民问题的立法努力时，格林议员大声插话。

sentences.en: Not really.
sentences.zh: 并非如此。

sentences.en: She begins heckling President Biden during his address, goading him to say her name and to directly address this case.
sentences.zh: 她在拜登总统演讲时开始起哄，怂恿他念出她的名字，并直接处理这个案件。

sentences.en: And so he does.
sentences.zh: 于是他照做了。

sentences.en: At least he attempts to.
sentences.zh: 至少他尝试了。

sentences.en: Lincoln...
sentences.zh: 林肯……

sentences.en: Lincoln Riley, an innocent young woman who was killed by an illegal...
sentences.zh: 林肯·莱利，一位无辜的年轻女性，被一名非法移民杀害……

sentences.en: In the process of trying to say her name, he mispronounces it, which has given more fodder to conservatives.
sentences.zh: 在试图念出她名字的过程中，他读错了音，这给保守派提供了更多的谈资。

sentences.en: But at the same time, he says that this is an innocent young woman who has been killed by an illegal,
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，他也表示这是一位被非法移民杀害的无辜年轻女性，

sentences.en: a term that is deeply offensive to many people on the left and immigration advocates for immigrants who see this term as just dehumanizing and pejorative.
sentences.zh: 这个词在左翼人士和移民权益倡导者眼中极具冒犯性，他们认为这个词不仅非人化，而且带有贬义。

sentences.en: And so, in a way, he ends up juSt...
sentences.zh: 所以，在某种程度上，他最终……

sentences.en: Pleasing no one.
sentences.zh: 谁也没讨好。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: He just wades right into this mess and just makes it even worse in some ways.
sentences.zh: 他直接卷入了这场混乱，甚至在某些方面让情况变得更糟了。

sentences.en: He just offends everyone across the board.
sentences.zh: 他把所有人都得罪了个遍。

sentences.en: So, by this point, the death of Lake and Riley has gone national into the most watched presidential speech of the year.
sentences.zh: 所以，到目前为止，莱肯·莱利的死已经成为全国关注的焦点，登上了年度收视率最高的总统演讲。

sentences.en: Where does it go from there?
sentences.zh: 接下来会怎样？

sentences.en: It goes right to the center of President Trump's campaign this year.
sentences.zh: 它直接成为了特朗普总统今年竞选活动的中心议题。

sentences.en: From 2016 on, Trump has focused a lot of his attention on illegal immigration.
sentences.zh: 从2016年开始，特朗普就将大量注意力集中在非法移民问题上。

sentences.en: And he's tried to portray undocumented immigrants as violent and used a lot of incendiary language, even playing on racial stereotypes and anxieties,
sentences.zh: 他试图将无证移民描绘成暴力分子，并使用了许多煽动性语言，甚至利用种族刻板印象和焦虑情绪，

sentences.en: to try to describe the menace that he says they have been to the country.
sentences.zh: 来描述他所说的这些人对国家构成的威胁。

sentences.en: And now, suddenly, as his campaign is heating up again, and he returns to this theme of illegal immigration,
sentences.zh: 而现在，随着他的竞选活动再次升温，他又回到了非法移民这个主题上，

sentences.en: he has a villain that he can point to as representative of everything that he has been arguing for years.
sentences.zh: 他找到了一个可以指出的“恶棍”，作为他多年来一直主张的观点的代表。

sentences.en: And so, Trump and his allies just bring this case up exhaustively.
sentences.zh: 于是，特朗普和他的盟友们不遗余力地反复提及这个案件。

sentences.en: He was assaulted, beaten, and horrifically murdered by an illegal alien.
sentences.zh: 他遭到了一名非法移民的袭击、殴打和残忍杀害。

sentences.en: They bring it up at rallies.
sentences.zh: 他们在集会上提起。

sentences.en: They bring it up in advertisements and in conservative media.
sentences.zh: 他们在广告和保守派媒体中提起。

sentences.en: Lake and Riley should have been able to go on a run in broad daylight without being murdered by an illegal immigrant.
sentences.zh: 莱肯·莱利本应能够在光天化日之下跑步，而不至于被一名非法移民杀害。

sentences.en: All in an effort to paint this case as something widespread or common.
sentences.zh: 这一切都是为了将此案描绘成一种普遍或常见的现象。

sentences.en: How many more killers has Biden set free?
sentences.zh: 拜登还放走了多少杀人犯？

sentences.en: In the interview, it is representative of this bigger failure on the part of the Biden administration to crack down on illegal immigration and to crack down on the southern border.
sentences.zh: 在采访中，这代表了拜登政府在打击非法移民和南部边境管控方面的更大失败。

sentences.en: And they frame this case as just the tip of an iceberg.
sentences.zh: 他们将此案描述为冰山一角。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And it felt like the Biden campaign was struggling when Biden was the nominee to respond to this because this incident had occurred on his watch.
sentences.zh: 当拜登作为候选人时，拜登竞选团队似乎很难对此做出回应，因为这起事件是在他的任期内发生的。

sentences.en: And there had been a meaningful rise in illegal immigration when he was president.
sentences.zh: 而且在他担任总统期间，非法移民数量确实出现了显著增长。

sentences.en: But I want to just pause, Rick, and ask, based on your reporting, how representative what Jose Ibarra is accused of doing here really is of undocumented immigrants?
sentences.zh: 但我还是想暂停一下，里克，根据你的报道，何塞·伊瓦拉被指控的行为在多大程度上代表了无证移民？

sentences.en: According to Trump and Republicans, this is common.
sentences.zh: 在特朗普和共和党人看来，这是常态。

sentences.en: This is a real threat.
sentences.zh: 这是一个真正的威胁。

sentences.en: What's the actual reality of it?
sentences.zh: 实际情况究竟如何？

sentences.en: I mean, this is very clearly an aberration.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这显然是一个反常现象。

sentences.en: What Jose Ibarra is accused of doing is in no way reflective of the intentions or the actions of the vast majority of the people who are undocumented and who enter the United States.
sentences.zh: 何塞·伊瓦拉被指控的行为，绝不能反映绝大多数无证进入美国的移民的意图或行为。

sentences.en: The studies have repeatedly shown the opposite, that this is a population that is doing everything they can to avoid detection, to keep their head down.
sentences.zh: 研究一再表明事实恰恰相反，这个群体正在尽一切努力避免被发现，保持低调。

sentences.en: And, you know, their intention is not to come here and so unrest and to perpetrate violence.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，他们的目的不是来这里制造动乱和实施暴力。

sentences.en: It's really to get away from something else and seek economic opportunity.
sentences.zh: 他们其实是为了逃离其他困境，寻求经济机会。

sentences.en: And so while this case is very much real, it's not necessarily an indictment of undocumented people more broadly.
sentences.zh: 所以，虽然这个案件确实真实存在，但它并不一定是对更广泛的无证移民群体的控诉。

sentences.en: But President Trump and other conservatives have highlighted this case because it so neatly makes the point that they want to make,
sentences.zh: 但特朗普总统和其他保守派人士强调这个案件，是因为它非常巧妙地证明了他们想要表达的观点，

sentences.en: even if the evidence more broadly doesn't bear this out.
sentences.zh: 即使更广泛的证据并不支持这一点。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Of course, for many Americans, one murder by somebody who is in the United States unlawfully is going to be one murder to many.
sentences.zh: 当然，对许多美国人来说，任何一名非法居留者犯下的谋杀案，哪怕只有一起也太多了。

sentences.en: But even if the end of Jose Ibarra's journey in the United States is rare, a violent act, a murder,
sentences.zh: 但即使何塞·伊瓦拉在美国的经历最终是罕见的暴力行为、谋杀案，

sentences.en: it feels like the rest of his journey feels much more common for somebody who comes here illegally.
sentences.zh: 但对于一个非法来到这里的人来说，他经历的其他部分似乎要普遍得多。

sentences.en: He enters the country, he's given taxpayer-funded resources in multiple locations, and he is not deported even when he does have encounters with law enforcement.
sentences.zh: 他进入了这个国家，在多个地方获得了纳税人资助的资源，即使在与执法部门接触时也没有被驱逐出境。

sentences.en: And that part of the story on its own for a lot of people is very problematic.
sentences.zh: 而故事的这一部分本身，对很多人来说就非常有问题。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: One murder is too many for sure.
sentences.zh: 一起谋杀案确实太多了。

sentences.en: But I think, as you said, Ibarra's entire journey touches on many people's frustrations, where the system is falling short, and how migrants in these situations are treated.
sentences.zh: 但我认为，正如你所说，伊瓦拉的整个经历触及了许多人的挫败感，即体制在哪些方面做得不足，以及这些情况下的移民是如何被对待的。

sentences.en: And I think there's just this underlying sense of fairness that I think drives a lot of the opposition.
sentences.zh: 我认为这背后有一种潜在的公平感，我认为这驱动了很大一部分反对意见。

sentences.en: You know, before the election, when I talked to voters, I heard about that, about the resources, about the taxpayer dollars that have gone to supporting these migrants,
sentences.zh: 你知道，在选举前，当我与选民交谈时，我听到了这些，关于资源，关于用于支持这些移民的纳税人的钱，

sentences.en: that they're getting access to support and a pathway to a secure place in this country that doesn't exist for other people.
sentences.zh: 他们获得了支持，并在这个国家获得了一个安身之所，而其他人却没有这样的途径。

sentences.en: They look at Jose Ibarra and say, why did this person get a hotel room in New York City paid for by the government?
sentences.zh: 他们看着何塞·伊瓦拉，问道：为什么这个人能在纽约市住上政府买单的酒店房间？

sentences.en: Why was he flown to Georgia on the taxpayer's dime?
sentences.zh: 为什么他能用纳税人的钱飞往佐治亚州？

sentences.en: And whether you think this is a good use of money or not, those are the questions that are being asked.
sentences.zh: 无论你认为这是否是金钱的合理使用，这些都是人们正在提出的问题。

sentences.en: Why is someone who is here unlawfully getting something that U.S.
sentences.zh: 为什么一个非法居留的人能得到美国公民得不到的东西？

sentences.en: citizens aren't?
sentences.zh: 你知道，这怎么说得通？

sentences.en: You know, how does that make sense?
sentences.zh: 这怎么说得通？

sentences.en: And then on top of all these questions of fairness, now you have this murder.
sentences.zh: 而在所有这些关于公平的问题之上，现在又发生了这起谋杀案。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And after this presidential campaign from Donald Trump, in which he makes immigration, and at times this case, which he has invoked such a big part of his message,
sentences.zh: 在唐纳德·特朗普的总统竞选活动之后，他将移民问题，有时甚至是这个案件，作为他竞选信息的重要组成部分，

sentences.en: Trump wins the election, he wins Georgia, where this crime happened, among other swing states,
sentences.zh: 特朗普赢得了选举，赢得了这起罪案发生的佐治亚州，以及其他摇摆州，

sentences.en: and millions of voters, tens of millions of voters, effectively endorse his call for mass deportation on a scale we have never seen before in the United States.
sentences.zh: 数以千万计的选民实际上支持了他那前所未有的、大规模驱逐出境的呼吁。

sentences.en: He's calling for millions of people to be deported, and in his telling, somebody like Jose Ibarra is exactly who should be deported when that mass deportation starts.
sentences.zh: 他呼吁驱逐数百万人，按照他的说法，当大规模驱逐开始时，像何塞·伊瓦拉这样的人正是应该被驱逐的对象。

sentences.en: And then, as fate would have it, right after this election, in fact, I think just two weeks after this election, this murder trial of Jose Ibarra begins in Athens, Georgia.
sentences.zh: 而且，正如命运安排的那样，就在这次选举之后，事实上，我想就在选举两周后，何塞·伊瓦拉的谋杀案审判在佐治亚州雅典市开始了。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And the trial moves faSt.
sentences.zh: 审判进展很快。

sentences.en: The defense was concerned about being able to find a jury in Athens, a city that was just rattled by this killing, who could dispassionately hear the evidence and render a verdict.
sentences.zh: 辩方担心在雅典市无法找到陪审团，因为这座城市刚刚被这起杀人案震惊，他们担心陪审员无法冷静地听取证据并做出裁决。

sentences.en: So they ask for a bench trial instead, meaning it's the judge who decided whether or not he was guilty.
sentences.zh: 所以他们要求进行法官审判，这意味着由法官来决定他是否有罪。

sentences.en: And so, after four days of testimony, the judge reaches his verdict.
sentences.zh: 因此，在四天的证词陈述后，法官做出了裁决。

sentences.en: And he delivers it just 15 minutes after the lawyers had finished their closing arguments.
sentences.zh: 他在律师结束结案陈词仅15分钟后就宣读了判决。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: He did not hesitate.
sentences.zh: 他没有犹豫。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: He found him guilty.
sentences.zh: 他判决他有罪。

sentences.en: And then, later in the afternoon, he sentenced Ibarra to life in prison without the possibility of parole.
sentences.zh: 随后，在当天下午晚些时候，他判处伊瓦拉终身监禁，不得假释。

sentences.en: And Rick, now that Jose Ibarra has been convicted and sentenced, how do we think that this case will live on in a post-election world
sentences.zh: 里克，既然何塞·伊瓦拉已经被定罪并判刑，我们认为这个案件在后选举时代将如何延续下去？

sentences.en: in which the president-elect and soon-to-inaugurated President Trump is talking so much about illegal immigration and mass deportation?
sentences.zh: 在这个时代，当选总统、即将就职的特朗普正在大谈非法移民和大规模驱逐出境。

sentences.en: I think he, just a day or so ago, mentioned a plan to invoke a national emergency and use the military to carry out mass deportation.
sentences.zh: 我想就在一两天前，他还提到了一个计划，即宣布国家进入紧急状态，并动用军队来执行大规模驱逐。

sentences.en: What happens to this case, given how it has now been resolved in that context?
sentences.zh: 考虑到这个案件现在已经解决，在这样的背景下，它会发生什么？

sentences.en: So this guilty verdict is already being embraced as validation by the people who have raised the profile of this case from the very beginning.
sentences.zh: 所以，这个有罪判决已经被那些从一开始就提升此案关注度的人视为一种验证。

sentences.en: You know, the people who have wanted to focus on this case as a justification for cracking down on illegal immigration.
sentences.zh: 你知道，那些一直想把这个案件作为打击非法移民理由的人。

sentences.en: Not long after the verdict on Wednesday, Trump came out and celebrated it and linked it to his plan for deportation.
sentences.zh: 周三判决后不久，特朗普就出来庆祝，并将其与他的驱逐计划联系起来。

sentences.en: He said, it's time to secure our border and remove these criminals and thugs from our country so nothing like this can happen again.
sentences.zh: 他说，是时候确保我们的边境安全，并将这些罪犯和暴徒从我们的国家清除出去，这样类似的事情就不会再发生了。

sentences.en: And so clearly this case is going to be a part of how this new administration makes the case for mass deportation.
sentences.zh: 显然，这个案件将成为本届新政府为大规模驱逐出境辩护的一部分。

sentences.en: The outcome of this election and the outcome of this trial all but ensured that this case is going to live on in some way for a very long time.
sentences.zh: 这次选举的结果和这次审判的结果，几乎确保了这个案件将在很长一段时间内以某种方式持续存在。

sentences.en: Well, Rick, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 好的，里克，非常感谢。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的其他消息。

sentences.en: On Wednesday,
sentences.zh: 周三，

sentences.en: the Republicans who control the House Ethics Committee blocked the release of a report into allegations of sexual misconduct and drug use by former Representative Matt Gaetz,
sentences.zh: 控制众议院道德委员会的共和党人阻止发布一份关于前众议员马特·盖茨性行为不端和吸毒指控的报告，

sentences.en: President-elect Trump's pick to be Attorney General.
sentences.zh: 他是当选总统特朗普提名的司法部长人选。

sentences.en: Senators from both parties have asked to see the report as they try to vet Gaetz, but the Republican House Speaker, Mike Johnson, a close Trump ally,
sentences.zh: 两党的参议员都要求查看这份报告，以便对盖茨进行审查，但共和党众议院议长、特朗普的亲密盟友迈克·约翰逊，

sentences.en: has pressured the Ethics Committee not to make the report's findings public.
sentences.zh: 向道德委员会施压，要求不要公开报告的调查结果。

sentences.en: And the Department of Justice is asking that Google be forced to sell its popular web browser, Chrome.
sentences.zh: 此外，司法部要求强制谷歌出售其流行的网络浏览器Chrome。

sentences.en: The request was made to a federal judge who ruled back in August that Google has maintained an illegal monopoly in online search.
sentences.zh: 这一请求是向一位联邦法官提出的，该法官曾在8月份裁定谷歌在在线搜索领域维持了非法垄断地位。

sentences.en: If the judge accepts the plan, it could radically reshape Google's business.
sentences.zh: 如果法官接受该计划，可能会从根本上重塑谷歌的业务。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Alex Stern, Sidney Harper, Luke Vanderplug, and Muj Zadien.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由亚历克斯·斯特恩、西德尼·哈珀、卢克·范德普鲁格和穆吉·扎迪恩制作。

sentences.en: It was edited by Liz O'Balen and Maria Byrne, with help from Rachel Quester.
sentences.zh: 由利兹·奥巴伦和玛丽亚·伯恩编辑，瑞秋·奎斯特提供协助。

sentences.en: Contains original music by Diane Wong, Mary Lozano, Dan Powell, and Pat McCusker, and was engineered by Chris Wood.
sentences.zh: 包含黛安·黄、玛丽·洛萨诺、丹·鲍威尔和帕特·麦卡斯克创作的原创音乐，由克里斯·伍德进行工程制作。

sentences.en: Our theme music is by Jim Brunberg and Ben Lansford of Wonderly.
sentences.zh: 我们的主题音乐由Wonderly的吉姆·布伦伯格和本·兰斯福德创作。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Bobarro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个严密控制的机器运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 当时选举迎来了一批自称改革者的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直处于一场痛苦、混乱，有时又令人兴奋的斗争中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在《地铁》的最新一集中，我和莎拉·凯尼格将讲述人们试图维持影响力却在过程中失去控制的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《地铁》。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 在任何你收听播客的地方订阅我们。
